title: Auditing Shapley rankings under incomplete measurement coverage: data and reproducible code
description: Data and reproducible code for auditing Shapley rankings under incomplete measurement coverage. Version 9 adds measured-score completion witnesses, independent NIMS La-Fe-Si analysis, utility sensitivity, a three-player ranking example, paired adaptive and nonveto acquisition comparisons, NIMS certificate thresholds and single-revelation obstructions, and sparse and coverage-sensitive runtime checks. A saved-world diagnostic documents nonmonotone early recovery even without observation noise. The separate version 8 archive remains the source of the original long calibration world tables; those long benchmarks were not rerun. No new alloy experiments or optimal acquisition policy are claimed.
